title: NAFEMS LE10 thick plate
sentence: LE1's elliptic membrane extruded into a 3D plate under uniform pressure — a 3D solid benchmark.
theory: NAFEMS Standard Benchmark LE10: hex20 or tet10 elements converge to σyy(D) = −5.38 MPa within 2 %; hex8 shows the linear-element bending error the benchmark is known for.
